answer.rationale: Do not match the competitor with promotional pricing: recovered exp_73 shows targeted discounts raised signup and qualified revenue but reduced 30-day retention by 12%, undermining the primary objective of sustainable qualified revenue. Referral incentives have added qualified revenue among established customers without measurable retention harm, making them the lowest-known downstream-risk response available today. Limit the launch to established customers and monitor referral quality, retention, and incremental revenue versus baseline.
